name: Am I Me Doubleganger Delirium
source:
Months after being kidnapped you notice that your kidnapper hasn't been around for days. Is this finally your chance to escape or is this the beginning of something much much worse.

[from [url=https://swordbrine.itch.io/am-i-me]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
被绑架几个月后，你发现绑匪已经好几天没有出现了。这是你最终逃脱的机会还是更糟糕的事情的开始。

[来自[url=https://swordbrine.itch.io/am-i-me]itch.io[/url]]
